title: Comply with the Australian Privacy Principles
what: Handle personal information as the Australian Privacy Principles require, once annual turnover passes $3 million.

sources.title: Privacy Act 1988
sources.quote: An APP entity must not do an act, or engage in a practice, that breaches an Australian Privacy Principle.

triggers.unit: AUD annual turnover in a financial year
triggers.note: Small business operators are exempt; a business with turnover above $3 million in any financial year since it started is not a small business operator.
